name: Research brief
objective: Answer a specific research question with traceable evidence.
definitionOfDone: Answer the agreed question and distinguish evidence from inference.
Deliver a cited report that states uncertainty and limitations.

name: Outreach campaign
objective: Run a bounded, authorized outreach campaign.
definitionOfDone: Complete authorized contacts or document why they could not be contacted.
Report responses, opt-outs, costs and remaining follow-ups.
deliverable: A campaign outcome report and contact record

name: Market or competitor scan
objective: Compare a defined market or set of competitors using recorded sources.
definitionOfDone: Compare the agreed entities on explicit criteria.
Deliver cited findings and identify gaps or unsupported assumptions.
deliverable: A sourced comparison and findings memo

name: Content production
objective: Produce the agreed content for its intended audience.
definitionOfDone: Deliver the requested assets against the brief.
Record a quality check and flag factual claims that lack sources.
deliverable: Versioned content assets and a quality report

name: Run a business
objective: Build a legitimate, profitable business using recorded customer evidence.
deliverable: An operating business with recorded payments, costs and delivery outcomes

name: Custom
objective: Define the outcome the team should achieve.
definitionOfDone: Deliver the specified result and evidence against the agreed acceptance conditions.
